subject: Marketplace onboarding: questions on offer metadata, SSO redirect, and identity proofs
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <azure.marketplace@microsoft.com>, Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@contoso.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: questions on offer metadata, SSO redirect, and identity proofs

Hi team,

Thanks for the initial intake form — a few items came up while we're preparing the offer package and I wanted to confirm before we submit into the publisher portal. Short list: 

1) Offer metadata: the portal requests a "Publisher display name" and a separate "Company legal name" field. We want these to map to Redwood Inference (display) and Redwood Inference, Inc. (legal). Is that the correct mapping for public listing vs tax/contracting?

2) SSO / redirect URIs: our product uses a few callback endpoints for the Hosted API console and self-serve onboarding. The portal only allows a single redirect setting per offer. Can you confirm whether we should supply a comma-separated list in the manifest or open a support ticket for additional URIs?

3) Identity proofs: the technical gate asks for certificate of incorporation and a government ID. We can provide a PDF bundle. Any preferred naming convention or minimum DPI?

I've attached the draft manifest and our identity bundle for your intake. If you need a brief call, Grace and I are available this afternoon 1–4pm PT.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships (Marketplaces)
Redwood Inference
Attachment: publisher_identity_proof.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: redwood-offer-manifest.json (json)

From: Azure Marketplace Team <azure.marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: questions on offer metadata, SSO redirect, and identity proofs

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the clear note and the attachments — we've pulled your manifest into the intake queue (ticket AZMP-11894). Quick answers inline: 

1) Publisher display name vs legal name: yes, map as you suggested. Display name is what appears in the marketplace. Legal name is used for contracting and payout. Leave tax ID blank for now if you don't have a marketplace payout profile set up — that will come later.

2) Redirect URIs: the modern publisher portal supports multiple redirect URIs, but they need to be submitted in the offer manifest under the webAuth.redirects array. If you have >10 entries or wildcard hosts, please open a support ticket and reference AZMP-11894 — those require manual validation. If you prefer, include a single placeholder in the manifest and we'll expand during technical validation.

3) Identity proofs: PDF is fine. Minimum 150 DPI recommended. File names should be offername_YYYYMMDD_type.pdf (e.g., redwood_20261110_inc.pdf). Please avoid password-protected files.

Next steps: update the manifest to include webAuth.redirects and re-upload. Also please add a short description of any network peering or private endpoint requirements in the Azure-specific technical checklist section — our validation team needs that to advise on plan SKUs.

Cc'ing our validation lead Paul here for any additional checks. We can do a short 20-min screen share tomorrow if that helps.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Onboarding (Validation)
Support: AZMP-11894
Attachment: marketplace-validation-checklist.docx (docx)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <azure.marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Paul Bennett <paul.bennett@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: questions on offer metadata, SSO redirect, and identity proofs

Paul / validation team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We made the updates you recommended and re-attached:
- redwood-offer-manifest.json (now includes webAuth.redirects array with our six known callbacks and placeholders for region aliases)
- sso-redirects.csv (human-friendly list matching the manifest)
- publisher_identity_proof.pdf (renamed per your convention)

Note on network topology: Dedicated (Dedicated Capacity) offers will require a private endpoint option. We're listing this under "networkRequirements": {"privateEndpoint": "supported"} in the manifest; let us know if that needs to be a separate support request.

We can do a 20-min call tomorrow 9:30–9:50am PT — inviting Grace as technical owner.

Best,
Olga
Attachment: sso-redirects.csv (csv)
Attachment: redwood-offer-manifest.json (json)
Attachment: publisher_identity_proof.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Team <azure.marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: questions on offer metadata, SSO redirect, and identity proofs

Looping in quick technical confirmation from the infra side. Two notes for validation team / Paul: 

- Our hosted console uses strict redirect checking; the six URIs in the manifest are exact-match endpoints, no wildcards. We will host the callbacks behind CloudFront and expect the marketplace validation to accept https://console.redwoodinference.com/.auth/callback and the other 5 entries.
- Private endpoint support: we implement Azure Private Link on the Dedicated SKU only; it's opt-in and requires tenant-level network configuration. We've added the tenant ID and preferred private endpoint subnets to the technical appendix (see uploaded manifest). If the validation flow needs any additional Azure subscription proofs (subscription ID or service principal), please flag and we'll produce them.

Happy to be on the 9:30am PT call and run through the redirect demo live.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Platform Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: infra-notes.txt (txt)
